styles.label: History
styles.blurb: The imperial palace, the Qing tombs and the 918 Museum.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Northeast dumplings, barbecue and street snacks.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, old streets and the industrial heritage.

stays.why: Walk to the Imperial Palace and the old shopping streets. Best base for first-timers.
Central shopping and food street, close to the Shenyang Station and easy metro links.
Handy for high-speed trains and the metro; good value hotels and quick airport links.
Newer, quieter district with parks and the provincial museum area; needs transport to the old sights.

food: Try Northeast classics: dumplings (饺子), guobaorou (sweet-and-sour pork) and stewed chicken with mushrooms.
Shenyang barbecue is a local ritual: grill at the table, order lamb skewers and cold beer.
Old streets near the Imperial Palace have snack stalls; prices are low, so pay in cash or by QR code.
Korean food is common and good here, thanks to the nearby border region; look for cold noodles and grilled meat.
Winter is hotpot season. Book popular places on weekends; expect queues after 6pm.
more_time: Add a half-day for the 918 History Museum; it is large and sobering, so allow time.
Swap one city day for the Dongling tomb park if you have already seen Beiling.
In summer, take a slower afternoon in a park or teahouse instead of another museum.

recommend.why: Two nights cover the Imperial Palace, one Qing tomb and a good food evening; add a night for the 918 Museum and Dongling.

month_notes: January: very cold, highs around -4°C and lows near -14°C. Dress in layers and plan indoor sights.
February: still freezing, highs near 0°C. Few rainy days; watch for ice on pavements.
March: warming to about 9°C but windy and dusty. A light coat is enough by late month.
April: pleasant at around 17°C. Good for walking the old city and tomb parks.
May: mild and green, highs near 24°C. One of the best months to visit.
June: warm at about 28°C with more rain days. Carry a small umbrella.
July: hottest and wettest, highs near 30°C and about 14 rain days. Go out early.
August: hot and humid, similar to July. Indoor museums are a good midday plan.
September: comfortable again around 24°C. A strong month for parks and walking.
October: cool and clear at about 16°C. Great for sightseeing before the cold.
November: cold returns, highs near 5°C. Pack a warm coat.
December: freezing, highs near -3°C. Short days; check opening hours on the day.

climate_guide.summary: A cold northeast China climate: freezing winters, warm humid summers, and the best weather in spring and autumn.

items.title: Best time: April to May and September to October
items.text: Mild days around 16–24°C. Ideal for the palace, tomb parks and walking.

items.title: Winter is very cold
items.text: December to February highs sit near -4 to 0°C with lows around -14°C. Bring a heavy coat, hat and gloves.

items.title: Rain peaks in summer
items.text: July and August have the most rain days, around 13–14. Keep a compact umbrella handy.

items.title: Short hot summer
items.text: June to August reach about 28–30°C and stay humid. Plan outdoor sights for morning.

items.title: Spring can be windy and dusty
items.text: March and April are drier but breezy. A light scarf helps.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Warm layers and boots for winter; light clothes and rain gear for summer; a jacket for spring and autumn evenings.

transit.best: Metro for central sights and Didi for everything else.

modes.text: Lines 1, 2, 9 and 10 cover the city. Fares ¥2-5; trains run about 06:00-22:30.
Buses cost ¥1-2 and take cash or Alipay/WeChat QR codes. Routes are hard to read without Chinese.
Taxis start at ¥8 for 3 km then about ¥1.8/km; insist the meter is visible. Didi works well and is easiest for foreign visitors.
Not needed. Traffic and parking are hard for visitors; use metro and Didi instead.
Central sights in Shenhe are walkable. Beiling and Dongling need transport.
Tram line 2 links Taoxian Airport to the metro; the total trip downtown takes just over an hour.
